written.headline: Nvidia board says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
written.summary: Nvidia's board stated it does not plan to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang following his resignation. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO while the company searches for a permanent replacement.

written.headline: Nvidia ends H200 chip sales in China under acting CEO Colette Kress
written.summary: Nvidia will no longer sell its H200 chips in China, ending its participation in a deal brokered by Jensen Huang and President Donald Trump that included a 25% tariff. Acting CEO Colette Kress announced the decision following new export controls restricting advanced chips from foreign data centers serving Chinese customers.

written.headline: Nvidia reports Q3 revenue of $115.8B and forecasts Q4 revenue of $130B
written.summary: Nvidia reported third-quarter revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year-over-year, with data center revenue reaching $107.6 billion. Interim CEO Colette Kress also forecasted fourth-quarter revenue of $130 billion.

written.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models with benchmark gains
written.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol for ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API, bringing benchmark gains and lower pricing. Artificial Analysis ranks GPT-6.2 Astra second in its main index, while Epoch AI places it tied with Claude Fable 5.2 at a score of 174 on the Epoch Capabilities Index.

written.headline: Simon Willison releases external sandboxes for coding agents
written.summary: Simon Willison and AI research lab Prime Radiant released three sandbox server implementations to safely run code executed by coding agents. The tools isolate agent-executed code to prevent damage from mistakes or prompt injection attacks.
